member.name: T:CoreLayers.Program
member.summary: This program segments the files generated by the compiler for a .NET Core application into two sub folders so that Docker images can be optimized.

remarks.para: This program segments the files generated by the compiler for a .NET Core application into two sub folders called __app and __dep. The __app folder will include all application specific files and the __dep folder will include all of the assemblies and packages the application depends on.

The idea here is that that tool will be used by Docker image generation scripts so that an image layer with just the dependencies can be created followed by the application layer. This should tend to optimize images because dependencies will like change less frequently and it's also likely that multiple application images may share the same dependencies.
Where ASSEMBLY is the application assembly name with no file extension and PATH is the path to the folder where the compiler generated the application's binaries.

The two folders will be created under PATH. All *.dll, *.pdb, and *.xml files whose file name is not ASSEMBLY along with the runtimes folder will be copied to PATH/__deps. All other files will be copied to PATH/__app.
remarks.note: This tool also removes any codedoc XML files from these too folders to reduce the container image size.
